WITH erz AS (
    SELECT SUM(f.erzeugung_mwh) AS erzeugung_mwh
    FROM dw.fact_erzeugung f
    JOIN dw.dim_energietraeger e ON e.energietraeger_key = f.energietraeger_key
    JOIN dw.dim_region r ON r.region_key = f.region_key
    WHERE r.smard_code = N'DE-LU'
      AND e.name_de = N'Photovoltaik'
      AND f.datum_key BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
), monat AS (
    SELECT k.datum_key, SUM(k.bestand_mw) AS bestand_mw
    FROM dw.fact_kapazitaet k
    JOIN dw.dim_energietraeger e ON e.energietraeger_key = k.energietraeger_key
    WHERE e.name_de = N'Photovoltaik'
      AND k.datum_key BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251201
    GROUP BY k.datum_key
), kap AS (
    SELECT AVG(bestand_mw) AS avg_bestand_mw FROM monat
)
SELECT erz.erzeugung_mwh / kap.avg_bestand_mw AS volllaststunden
FROM erz CROSS JOIN kap

WITH erz AS (
    SELECT SUM(f.erzeugung_mwh) AS erzeugung_mwh
    FROM dw.fact_erzeugung f

      AND e.name_de = N'Photovoltaik'

    SELECT k.datum_key, SUM(k.bestand_mw) AS bestand_mw

    WHERE e.name_de = N'Photovoltaik'
      AND k.datum_key BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251201

), kap AS (

)
SELECT erz.erzeugung_mwh / kap.avg_bestand_mw AS volllaststunden

WITH jahr_summe AS (
    SELECT d.jahr, SUM(f.erzeugung_mwh) AS erzeugung_mwh
    FROM dw.fact_erzeugung f
    JOIN dw.dim_energietraeger e ON e.energietraeger_key = f.energietraeger_key

    JOIN dw.dim_datum d ON d.datum_key = f.datum_key
    WHERE r.smard_code = N'DE-LU'
      AND e.name_de = N'Photovoltaik'
      AND d.jahr BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
    GROUP BY d.jahr
)
SELECT jahr, erzeugung_mwh,
       100.0 * (erzeugung_mwh - LAG(erzeugung_mwh) OVER (ORDER BY jahr))
             / LAG(erzeugung_mwh) OVER (ORDER BY jahr) AS veraenderung_prozent

WITH monat AS (

           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.kategorie_de = N'Erneuerbar' THEN f.erzeugung_mwh END)
                 / SUM(f.erzeugung_mwh) AS ee_anteil_prozent
    FROM dw.fact_erzeugung f
    JOIN dw.dim_energietraeger e ON e.energietraeger_key = f.energietraeger_key
    JOIN dw.dim_region r ON r.region_key = f.region_key
    JOIN dw.dim_datum d ON d.datum_key = f.datum_key
    WHERE r.smard_code = N'DE-LU'
      AND d.jahr = 2025

WITH tag AS (
    SELECT d.datum, AVG(p.day_ahead_eur_mwh) AS tagesmittel_eur_mwh
    FROM dw.fact_preis p
    JOIN dw.dim_region r ON r.region_key = p.region_key
    JOIN dw.dim_datum d ON d.datum_key = p.datum_key
    WHERE r.smard_code = N'DE-LU'
      AND p.datum_key BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250614
    GROUP BY d.datum
)
SELECT datum, tagesmittel_eur_mwh,
       AVG(tagesmittel_eur_mwh) OVER (ORDER BY datum ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

WITH zubau AS (
    SELECT b.name_de, SUM(k.zubau_mw) AS zubau_mw
    FROM dw.fact_kapazitaet k
    JOIN dw.dim_bundesland b ON b.bundesland_key = k.bundesland_key
    JOIN dw.dim_energietraeger e ON e.energietraeger_key = k.energietraeger_key
    WHERE e.name_de = N'Wind Onshore'
      AND k.datum_key BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251201
    GROUP BY b.name_de
), rk AS (
    SELECT name_de, zubau_mw, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY zubau_mw DESC) AS rang
    FROM zubau
)

FROM rk
WHERE rang <= 3

WITH monat AS (
    SELECT d.jahr, d.monat, SUM(l.netzlast_mwh) AS netzlast_mwh
    FROM dw.fact_last l
    JOIN dw.dim_region r ON r.region_key = l.region_key
    JOIN dw.dim_datum d ON d.datum_key = l.datum_key
    WHERE r.smard_code = N'DE-LU'
      AND l.datum_key BETWEEN 20241201 AND 20251231
    GROUP BY d.jahr, d.monat
), vm AS (
    SELECT jahr, monat, netzlast_mwh,
           100.0 * (netzlast_mwh - LAG(netzlast_mwh) OVER (ORDER BY jahr, monat))
                 / LAG(netzlast_mwh) OVER (ORDER BY jahr, monat) AS veraenderung_prozent
    FROM monat
)
